description:
Hi, I'm Pouse and welcome to my channel POUSE around the HOUSE. I provide tutorials and vlogs for all tasks around the home, from basic DIY, furniture assembly, tool reviews and motoring tips, to appliance user instructions,  plastering walls, a full loft conversion and anything in between!! Hopefully my channel will inspire you to have a go and do it yourself which can be very rewarding and save you money.

I'm always happy to receive new products to test and review on my channel so please email me at pouse82@gmail.com and I'll do my best to get back to you.
